webviewTimeout: Maximum seconds for Webview initialization, reply delivery, or an opening history snapshot. Timed out views can be reloaded without stopping backend work.
inlineStatic: Embed all official static assets in the Webview HTML. Optional workaround for slow remote resource requests; increases initial transfer size. Reopen the view after changing.
maxTransfer: Maximum buffered attachment or API response size in MiB. Reopen the view after changing this setting.
connect: DeepSeek Harness: Connect to Running Backend
stop: DeepSeek Harness: Stop Current Workspace Backend
harnessPath: Harness installation directory: a checkout with apps/cli/lib/bin.js, or an installed @deepseek-ai/dsh package. Empty discovers it from the workspace or a global npm installation. Node.js is located automatically.
home: Harness data directory. Empty uses the official default. Explicitly stop the workspace backend before applying changes.
timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for the backend startup URL.
settingsPath: Optional absolute settings document path for a custom or attached backend.
binPath: Absolute path to the official DSH bin.js. Takes precedence over harnessPath. Set on the machine running the extension.
queueRevealDelay: Delay in milliseconds before showing a newly opened message queue. Briefly queued messages do not flash above the input. Zero shows the queue immediately. Reopen the view after changing.
installTimeout: Maximum seconds for npx to install and verify the official DSH Web startup. Installation can also be cancelled from the progress notification.
